mapper.sql: id, user_id, source_type, source_id, topic, question, reference_answer, mastery_status, next_review_date, review_date_source, archived, created_at, updated_at

i.id AS item_id, i.source_type, i.source_id, i.topic, i.question, i.reference_answer, i.mastery_status, i.next_review_date, i.review_date_source, i.archived, i.created_at, i.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM practice_attempt a WHERE a.practice_item_id = i.id) AS attempt_count, (SELECT MAX(a.attempted_at) FROM practice_attempt a WHERE a.practice_item_id = i.id) AS last_attempt_at, (SELECT a.result FROM practice_attempt a WHERE a.practice_item_id = i.id ORDER BY a.attempted_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_result, (SELECT a.self_score FROM practice_attempt a WHERE a.practice_item_id = i.id ORDER BY a.attempted_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_self_score, COALESCE(r.session_id, t.session_id) AS source_session_id, COALESCE(rs.title, ts.title) AS source_session_title, COALESCE(rs.topic_mode, ts.topic_mode) AS source_topic_mode, COALESCE(rs.form, ts.form) AS source_form, r.total_score AS report_total_score, r.scoring_rule_version AS report_scoring_rule_version, t.question AS original_question, t.answer AS original_answer, t.answer_source AS original_answer_source, t.turn_type AS original_turn_type

LEFT JOIN interview_report r ON i.source_type = 'REPORT' AND r.id = i.source_id LEFT JOIN interview_session rs ON rs.id = r.session_id LEFT JOIN interview_turn t ON i.source_type = 'INTERVIEW_TURN' AND t.id = i.source_id LEFT JOIN interview_session ts ON ts.id = t.session_id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM practice_item i
ORDER BY CASE i.mastery_status WHEN 'NEW' THEN 0 WHEN 'LEARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, COALESCE(i.next_review_date, '9999-12-31') ASC, i.created_at DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT DISTINCT i.topic FROM practice_item i
ORDER BY i.topic
